title: Query 1 – EDAM operations of Bioconda packages
description: From two Bioconda packages, follow their bio.tools entries to the EDAM operations describing what they do, including operations inherited through the EDAM hierarchy.

title: Query 2 – resources per “Genetic variation” topic
description: Number of resources annotated with the EDAM topic “Genetic variation” and with each of its subtopics. Each row counts the resources annotated directly with that topic.

title: One tool across registries (ABySS)
description: The records describing ABySS in each source, with the version each one reports.

title: Sequence alignment resources per source
description: Tools and workflows performing “Sequence alignment” or any more specific EDAM operation, counted per source.

title: bio.tools entries packaged in Bioconda and BioContainers
description: Number of bio.tools entries that have both a Bioconda recipe and a BioContainer.

title: Most used licences
description: Licences across all sources. Values such as “None” or “Not licensed” show where licence metadata is missing.

title: EDAM operations in Galaxy workflows
description: The EDAM operations most often found in Galaxy workflows.

title: Most credited funders
description: Funders most often credited by tools and workflows.

title: What's in the graph: triples per source
description: Number of triples in each source. Each file is loaded as a named graph <urn:dataset:FILE>.
